subject: Hakimi scores first career hat trick with two assists as Luis Enrique becomes PSG's winningest coach
title: Hakimi's hat-trick and five contributions

lines.vo: Hakimi is a defender. He was involved in all five goals.
lines.footage: Hakimi hat trick PSG Le Havre

lines.vo: Three goals, two assists, his first career hat-trick. PSG beat Le Havre five-one.
He is the only defender with five goal contributions in a Ligue 1 game.
His previous best was two, in one hundred and thirty-five league games. He was saving up.
That night, Luis Enrique won his one hundred and twenty-seventh game as PSG coach. That passed Laurent Blanc for the club record.
lines.footage: Luis Enrique record PSG wins press conference

lines.vo: Hakimi finished thirteenth in the 2026 Ballon d'Or, sixteen places above Sadio Mane.
lines.footage: Hakimi free kick goal PSG October 2026

lines.vo: He is favourite for the CAF award in Lagos on the seventh of December. Strikers, look nervous.

inserts.story: A caricature of Hakimi wears a magician's top hat on the pitch. Gag: he pulls three balls out of the hat, one after another. Twist: two more doves fly out carrying assist signs.
A tiny cartoon piggy bank labelled with the number two sits on a shelf for a very long time. Gag: dusty cobwebs gather and a clock ticks 135. Twist: the piggy bank bursts open with five golden balls.
